public_api_verified: register immutable method without importing source
submit immutable ref or frozen alias with validated/defaulted parameters
execute checker and measurement in real CPU worker subprocess
recover result, raw output and frozen admitted materials
queued and running cancellation, cleanup acknowledgement
worker loss, attempt replacement and stale artifact publication rejection

recorded: attempt-bound raw artifact hashes, sizes and truncation/missing state

implemented_and_cpu_verified: Exact pinned compare_tensors with effective per-dtype thresholds, pass/fail and composite/integer outputs
Exact pinned KernelDetailsStrategy on original CSV: sum of per-kernel medians = 200 us for fixture
Public upload/submit/worker/recovery/artifact flow for both pinned components
Generic repeated/multi/conditional launch aggregation (not a live upstream profiler capture)
Archive path rejection, dependency packaging mechanics and private-install command construction
implemented_device_unverified: Task-scoped frozen source and candidate archive bridge
Original upstream CLI with supported descriptor parameters
Actual fixed-checkout packaging, native compilation, NPU correctness and profiler capture
Upstream/direct versus service full task differential
not_supported_or_not_claimed: All Config/BenchConfig/environment parameters in the sample adapter
All proto contracts, hooks, guards and HAP through numeric-only component
Large PROF exports exceeding bounded storage

limits.schema: Bounded Draft 2020-12 vocabulary; unsupported features rejected.
limits.runtime: Deployment-declared runtime and permissions; exact package/tool checks, no shared environment installation.
limits.trust: Caller method report is not service-certified correctness. Host mode is not a judge isolation boundary.
limits.storage: 1 MiB input/dependency artifact, 8 MiB frozen execution; bounded output/logs. See guide for detailed limits.
limits.compatibility: Existing operator endpoints/defaults and old results retained; added explicit method and cancelled states require matching client/API/worker builds.

server_acceptance_plan: Provision an isolated test worker with matching service build, qualified sandbox, exclusive NPU, CANN/msprof and exact pinned upstream-compatible dependencies.
Freeze upstream revision, task source, candidate, runtime versions, parameter defaults/overrides, and paired timing tolerances before measurement.
Run a multifile AscendC project through build, correctness and measurement; retain compiler/runtime/profiler evidence.
Run identical upstream task directly and via the full method harness, including correct/wrong/boundary/composite outputs, build/run failures and multiple kernels.
Compare case coverage, verdicts, scores and timing within the predeclared tolerance; retain both original reports and profiler captures.
Exercise NPU timeout, cancellation, worker loss and retry cleanup; verify no old attempt publishes evidence.
not_performed: Real NPU or full CANNBench acceptance
